= colon-xrefs(1)
:doctype: manpage
:manmanual: Cross-reference tests
:mansource: acdc

== Name
colon-xrefs - colon-containing local targets

== Synopsis

*colon-xrefs*

== Description

C01 <<:colon>> and <<:colon,Leading label>> and xref::colon[Leading macro] and xref:#:colon[Leading fragment].

C02 <<a-b.c:d>> and <<a-b.c:d,Mixed shorthand>> and xref:a-b.c:d[] and xref:a-b.c:d[Mixed macro] and xref:#a-b.c:d[Mixed fragment].

C03 <<topic:one>> and xref:topic:one[] and xref:#topic:one[Topic fragment].

C04 <<http:local>> and xref:http:local[Scheme-like ID].

C05 <<missing:one>> and xref:missing:one[Missing macro] and xref:#missing:one[Missing fragment].

C06 xref:guide.adoc#topic:one[Other document] and xref:https://example.org/guide#topic:one[External URL].

C07 <<Chapter: Details>> and xref:ordinary[Ordinary].

anchor::colon[Leading colon]Leading target.

[[a-b.c:d,Mixed ID]]
Mixed target.

[[topic:one,Topic One]]
Topic target.

[[http:local,Scheme-like local]]
Scheme-like target.

[[ordinary,Ordinary target]]
Ordinary target.

== Chapter: Details

C08 <<topic:one>> and xref:topic:one[Backward macro].

:colon-id: topic:one

C09 xref:{colon-id}[Attribute] and xref:pass:[topic:one][Passthrough] and <<pass:[a-b.c:d],Passed shorthand>>.

C10 \xref:topic:one[Escaped] and \<<topic:one>> and xref:topic:one[unfinished.

C11 xref:dir.name/topic:one[Directory dot] and <<missing.id,Missing dotted shorthand>> and xref:missing.id[External file].
